enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Shift position. Pull blanket down. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Wake up briefly. Check clock. Turn to left side. Close eyes. Remain still. Wake up at 6:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Heat pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt and pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. See bus arrive. Board bus. Insert card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone messages. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Look at watch. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Go to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Go to nurse station. Receive handover. Review patient charts. Pick up stethoscope. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient: 'Good morning, how are you feeling?' Check vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Walk to patient room 2. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check IV drip. Adjust flow rate.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Insert card. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home.
Enter home. Remove shoes. Hang up coat. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put feet up. Check phone. Put phone down.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add chicken. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes.

Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel.

Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type report. Save document. Close laptop. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Place book on table. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still.
